{"status":"answered","answer":"It depends on which Instant product you have. For the Instant Advance, there are no late fees, but you may be suspended from taking more advances, and if you repay more than 15 days after the due date, that suspension may last 30 days or more. For the Instant line of credit, late fees may apply in addition to a possible suspension from further draws. Let me know which product you mean if you'd like more detail.","citations":[{"source_id":"help-40059313140247","quote":"There are no late fees or interest for Albert Advances."},{"source_id":"help-360041602373","quote":"you may be suspended from accessing additional cash advances"},{"source_id":"help-360041602373","quote":"access to advances may be suspended for 30 days or more from when your repayment completes"},{"source_id":"help-40060432888471","quote":"late fees may apply and you may be suspended from accessing additional draws on your line of credit"}]}
